scope: Future calls only. Prior unguarded actions retain their execution gap; no reconstruction of missing standalone timestamps.

deltas.afterText:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
. "$PSScriptRoot/iam-model-local-meter-watchdog-review-fix-wait.ps1"
$root=$script:WatchdogRoot;$base="$root/.local/iam-model-frozen-prompt";$native='V:/.local/iam-model-frozen-prompt/native'
foreach($n in @('GIT_DIR','GIT_WORK_TREE','GIT_INDEX_FILE','GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY','GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES')){if(Test-Path "Env:$n"){Remove-Item "Env:$n"}}
$env:GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM='1';$env:GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL='NUL';$env:GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM='NUL';$env:GIT_ATTR_NOSYSTEM='1'
function Git($Name,$Directory,$Items){
 $r=Invoke-OwnBoundedProcess 'C:/Program Files/Git/cmd/git.exe' (@('-C',$Directory,'-c','core.autocrlf=false','-c','core.safecrlf=false','-c','core.whitespace=cr-at-eol','-c','core.quotepath=false','-c','core.fsmonitor=false','-c','core.attributesFile=NUL','-c','diff.external=')+$Items) 'own-native-git' "$base/native/$Name" 30
 if($r.timedOut -or $r.exit -ne 0){throw "NATIVE_FAILED_$Name"}
}
Git 'init-diff-batched' "$native/diff" @('init','--quiet')
foreach($batch in 1..9){Git "index-batch-$batch" "$native/diff" @('add',"--pathspec-from-file=$native/index-$batch.nul",'--pathspec-file-nul')}
$change=Invoke-OwnBoundedProcess (Get-Command python.exe).Source @('V:/.tools/iam-model-frozen-prompt-native.py','change') 'own-python-native-change' "$base/native/change-command" 30
if($change.timedOut -or $change.exit -ne 0){throw 'NATIVE_CHANGE_FAILED'}
Git 'new-intent' "$native/diff" @('add','--intent-to-add','--','model-gateway/src/test/java/cn/agentplatform/model/application/FrozenInitialPromptTest.java','model-gateway/src/test/java/cn/agentplatform/model/application/FrozenInitialPromptHttpTest.java','model-gateway/src/test/java/cn/agentplatform/model/application/FrozenInitialPromptFixture.java')
Git 'index-stage-audit' "$native/diff" @('ls-files','--stage','-z')
Git 'diff-check' "$native/diff" @('diff','--check','--no-ext-diff','--no-textconv')
Git 'diff' "$native/diff" @('diff','--binary','--full-index','--no-ext-diff','--no-textconv',"--output=$native/frozen-prompt.diff")
Git 'reviewed-diff' "$native/diff" @('diff','--binary','--full-index','--no-ext-diff','--no-textconv',"--output=$native/frozen-prompt-reviewed.diff")
Git 'name-status' "$native/diff" @('diff','--name-status')
Git 'init-replay' "$native/replay" @('init','--quiet')
Git 'apply-check' "$native/replay" @('apply','--check',"$native/frozen-prompt.diff")
Git 'apply' "$native/replay" @('apply','--whitespace=nowarn',"$native/frozen-prompt.diff")
$verify=Invoke-OwnBoundedProcess (Get-Command python.exe).Source @('V:/.tools/iam-model-frozen-prompt-native.py','verify') 'own-python-native-verify' "$base/native/verify-command" 30
if($verify.timedOut -or $verify.exit -ne 0){throw 'NATIVE_VERIFY_FAILED'}
